2610.08559.title: Latent space bias directions in LLMs capture confidence, not fairness
2610.08559.paper_summary: Activation steering has gained popularity as a lightweight inference-time debiasing technique for large language models. However, prior work reports that steering vectors generalise poorly, with unintended effects on model performance and limited transfer to new datasets. Our work analyses what the debiasing direction used for activation steering actually encodes, in order to shed light on its inconsistent performance. We study the linear debiasing direction obtained by contrasting the activations of anti-biased and biased prompts, and evaluate it as a steering intervention across bias and general knowledge benchmarks. We find that this direction is dominated by model confidence, pointing from regions of high to low-probability tokens in activation space rather than encoding a meaningful representation of model bias. Steering along it does reduce measured bias, but this is a consequence of reducing model confidence: on QA benchmarks we find that this steering drives the model to abstain from answering, with a side effect of improving fairness metrics. Our experiments show that model confidence is the dominant separating factor between biased and anti-biased prompts in hidden space, indicating that isolating a linear representation of bias which is disentangled from model confidence is difficult and steering-based debiasing results should be interpreted with care. In short, steering appears to reduce bias, not by correcting the model's underlying preferences, but by making it less confident, even on tasks unrelated to bias.
2610.08559.paper_summary_zh: 激活引導作為大型語言模型的輕量級推論時去偏見技術已獲得廣泛關注。<lb/>然而，先前的研究報告指出，引導向量的泛化能力較差，對模型性能產生意外影響，並且在新數據集上的轉移有限。<lb/>我們的研究分析了用於激活引導的去偏見方向實際上編碼了什麼，以便闡明其不一致的性能。<lb/>我們研究了通過對比反偏見和偏見提示的激活所獲得的線性去偏見方向，並在偏見和一般知識基準上評估其作為引導干預的效果。<lb/>我們發現，這一方向主要受模型信心的主導，指向激活空間中高概率標記到低概率標記的區域，而不是編碼模型偏見的有意義表徵。<lb/>沿著這一方向的引導確實減少了測量到的偏見，但這是因為降低了模型的信心：在問答基準上，我們發現這種引導使模型選擇不回答，並且副作用是改善了公平性指標。<lb/>我們的實驗顯示，模型信心是隱藏空間中偏見和反偏見提示之間的主要分隔因素，這表明將偏見的線性表徵與模型信心解耦是困難的，因此基於引導的去偏見結果應謹慎解讀。<lb/>總之，引導似乎減少了偏見，不是通過修正模型的基本偏好，而是通過使其信心降低，即使在與偏見無關的任務上也是如此。
